Created through NewRPM, sorted AddFileStream calls, and Write; compressor
"gzip:-1" matches Stapler's pinned nfpm rpm-lowmem default. BuildTime is Unix
zero, name nivora-repro+stplr-default, version 1, release alt1, arch x86_64,
license MIT. The two synthetic regular files belong to root:root, mode 0644:
  /usr/share/applications/demo.desktop (63 bytes)
  /usr/share/metainfo/com.example.Demo.metainfo.xml (518 bytes)

The writer records ARCHIVESIZE=LONGARCHIVESIZE=581 (sum of file bodies),
while the complete decompressed newc stream is 1016 bytes. Ubuntu 24.04
rpm2cpio 4.18.2 consequently exits 1 with empty stderr even when output goes
to a regular file. RPM digests pass. bsdtar extracts both files successfully.
The native regression requires rpm and bsdtar; it deliberately does not skip
when these declared development/CI dependencies are missing.
